answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the harbor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Every claim climbs the tundra of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the bridge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
